packages.title: Environment Agency — Landfill methane: measurement and metrics — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is England landfill methane measurement research.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-02-02.
The project assessed methods for measuring methane emissions from landfills and how measurement could support regulation.
The research considered two measurement methods and the effectiveness of landfill gas management.
Handling boundary: research-method evidence is not a parcel-level methane measurement.

packages.title: ONS — Atmospheric emissions: greenhouse gases by industry and gas — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is UK residence-basis greenhouse gases by SIC industry and gas, 1990 to 2024.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-06-05.
The dataset covers CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6, NF3 and total greenhouse gas emissions.
The dataset provides current and provisional editions and around 130 SIC 2007 industry categories.
Handling boundary: industry-level residence-basis statistics are not cadastral observations.

packages.title: ONS — UK Environmental Accounts: 2026 — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is UK Environmental Accounts residence-basis emissions and energy use.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-06-05.
ONS reports 478 MtCO2e of UK residence-basis greenhouse gas emissions in 2024.
The bulletin states that residence-basis emissions were 41.8% lower than in 1990.
Handling boundary: residence-basis totals must not be presented as territorial or parcel-level emissions.

packages.title: ONS — Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is Methodology for territorial, residence and footprint greenhouse-gas measures.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-07-07.
ONS distinguishes territorial, residence or production, and footprint or consumption measures.
The methodology explains that the three measures answer different accounting questions and are not directly interchangeable.
Handling boundary: accounting bases must remain explicit and separate.

packages.title: ONS — Energy use: renewable and waste sources — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is UK renewable and waste energy use by source and SIC section, 1990 to 2024.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-06-05.
The dataset covers renewable and waste energy sources including hydro, wind, wave and solar.
Values are energy-use activity data by industry, not direct greenhouse-gas measurements.
Handling boundary: energy use must not be converted to parcel emissions without an explicit supported model.
